description: A scrambled Rubik’s Cube sits on the wooden desk in front of the person, with both hands hovering nearby. The left hand moves in toward the cube from the left and the right hand approaches from the right, then they pick it up as a two-hand object and twist its layers in short quarter-turns—first shifting the cube slightly upward and left, then rotating it back down and right while the right hand makes most of the turning and the left hand steadies and regrips.
